confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from automated SQL injection attempts to a successful account takeover, privilege escalation, massive database querying, and large-scale data exfiltration, followed by an attempt to cover tracks by deleting logs.

attack_chain.description: Automated SQL injection attempts using sqlmap against the web server API.
Successful login of user_09 from an unusual IP (104.244.76.13) during off-hours.
Unauthorized privilege escalation where user_09 was elevated to 'dba' status.
Lateral movement to the database environment using the elevated credentials.
Massive database queries targeting the 'customers' table, affecting hundreds of thousands of rows.
Data exfiltration via DNS tunneling (UDP/53) to a known malicious domain.
Large-scale data exfiltration via HTTPS (TCP/443) totaling over 150MB.
Anti-forensic activity: deletion of the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log) to hide the intrusion.

gaps: Confirmation of whether user_09's actual credentials were stolen via the SQL injection or if it was a separate credential compromise.
Verification of the exact contents of the exfiltrated data.
narrative: An attacker used SQL injection to facilitate an account takeover of user_09, subsequently escalating privileges to DBA. The attacker then queried the customer database and exfiltrated over 150MB of data via DNS and HTTPS before attempting to delete authentication logs to evade detection.
